name: Cloudy Peak Traverse (South Ridge)
approach: Same as the East Route to Lyman Lake/Cloudy Pass — via the Lucerne/Holden Village/Railroad Creek trail from the east, cut off since January 28, 2026 by the Forest Service closure of the Lucerne dock and FR 8301 (order 06-17-05-26-04, through December 31, 2027), or via the Phelps Creek/Spider Gap trail from the west, whose Phelps Creek Trail #1511 is closed by the Little Giant Fire closure (order 06-17-07-2026-40, September 3 through October 31, 2026) and whose road, FR 6200, has been closed past Atkinson Flat since May 20, 2026 (order 06-17-07-2026-11, through December 31, 2027). From Lyman Lake or Cloudy Pass, gain the ridge crest at Cloudy Pass (6,440 ft) to start the traverse.
